note: Map3DRoyalPivot (LOCO-ROY-PROVIDER). march_phase: the one MARCH phase a royal pivot leaves and rejoins MARCH at, which is also the hold pose (coordinator ruling 2026-11-11: stop, start and hold only at admitted phases) - MARCH key 7/16, three hooves down, the frame nearest the stand. step_deg: every hoof steps once per this much turn, at least twice (the installed pivots' 12 steps a half turn). lift_m: a stepping hoof's rise mid-step in model metres, at most 0.4 of the distance it travels. support_m: a hoof whose lowest patch vertex is within this of the seated plane (or under it) at march_phase is planted; the others are in the air and step first and last. At 7/16 both fore hooves and the right hind are down (-2.7, +2.2, -1.8 mm); the left hind is 95 mm up. blend: the least share of the operation over which the body eases from MARCH to the stand and back (independent critic 2026-11-12: over one step of a 90 degree turn the rider's sword swing read as a flick). lift_share: the most a hoof rises for the distance it travels. patch_share / patch_band_m: a hoof's material patch is its body vertices with more than patch_share of their weight on the hoof bone, within patch_band_m of their lowest at rest; patch_band_m must equal the certifier config's.
